chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله would, on the Day of Sacrifice, shave his head, trim his nails, take from his mustache, and from the edges of his beard.

key_terms.يَوْمَ ٱلنَّحْرِ: the Day of Sacrifice during the rites of hajj

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله do on the Day of Sacrifice regarding shaving and grooming?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله on the Day of Sacrifice during hajj. It indicates a prophetic tradition of grooming that includes shaving the head, trimming the nails, shortening the mustache, and taking from the edges of the beard.
